description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 很长很细的图片不再让程序退出：截图读字时，三万多像素宽、几十像素高这样的长条图原来要占几个 GB 内存，有的电脑上会直接退出；现在和普通截图占得差不多，在这种图里找二维码也不再出错。权限不变。
notes.en: Long thin pictures no longer end it: reading the words in a strip tens of thousands of pixels wide and a few dozen high took several GB, and some PCs quit; it now takes about what a screenshot does, and looking for a QR code in such a picture no longer fails. Permissions unchanged.
